name: Brave Search API
summary: Web search from Brave's own independent index. Every plan includes $5 of free credit each month: 1,000 searches on the Search plan. Signing up needs a card.

allowance.text: $5 in free credits every month, applied automatically (each plan gets its own $5)

cost_per_query.basic_label: Web search on the Search plan ($5 per 1,000 requests)

rate_limits.note: Search plan capacity: 50 requests per second.

card_note: Card required: usage above the $5 monthly credit is billed. Brave lets you set usage limits in its dashboard and a monthly cap on auto-reload; signing up places a $0 or $1 card check that is refunded.
usage_terms_note: Brave describes the free credit as enough to run proofs of concept and power small-scale projects. Storing results (for example to train or tune a model) needs a plan that grants storage rights.
data_logging_note: Queries are kept for at most 90 days, for billing and troubleshooting. Brave says it collects no identifiers that link a query to a person or device.
